assertions.name: substrate_closure_vs_codata_within_1_percent
assertions.source: prop:flavor-dressed-mass-from-substrate-split closure: the substrate-pure formula matches CODATA m_n − m_p to within 1% modulo the dropped O((Δm/M_N)²) term. Measured residual at q_0: −0.53% (within the 1% gate).

assertions.name: upper_bound_strictly_respected
assertions.source: thm:flavor-mass-splitting-bound: the realised μ_d − μ_u must lie strictly below M_N · ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q and strictly above 0.  Boolean predicate enforces strict inequality (boundary values 0 and 1 fail).

assertions.name: substrate_value_strictly_positive
assertions.source: Positivity of substrate factor at q_0 > 1; gives μ_d − μ_u > 0 as required by hadronic physics.  Boolean predicate enforces strict positivity (negative values fail, including the boundary value 0).

description: Substrate-pure derivation of μ_d − μ_u from prop:flavor-split-substrate (substrate side) + lem:pair-skein-mass-formula (Skein lift).  Reports (a) the substrate-derived value, (b) closure vs CODATA m_n − m_p, and (c) the realised-vs-bound ratio against thm:flavor-mass-splitting-bound.  Calibration discipline: M_N is anchored on CODATA m_p + m_n (validation-tagged, Class-A acknowledged-stub pending Workplan-0b); q_0 is the substrate parameter (CAL-2). m_n − m_p itself is NOT an input — it is the derived quantity being predicted.

parameters.M_N_source: CODATA m_p + m_n / 2 (validation-tagged anchor; M_N substrate derivation pending — see docs/audits/2026-05-17-1ppb-workplan-v4.md)

data.delta_m_codata_role: validation target — NOT a production input.  Used only for closure cross-check vs the substrate-derived value.
